exzh: 爸爸為了我開了兩個小時的車，讓我能參加比賽。

en: Girls account for more than half of the students in our club.
exzh: 我們社團裡女生佔了一半以上。

en: Ben plays the piano, and he sings as well.
exzh: Ben 會彈鋼琴，也會唱歌。

en: Most birds use their wings to fly. In the case of penguins, their wings are used for swimming.
exzh: 大多數鳥類用翅膀飛行，但就企鵝來說，牠們的翅膀是用來游泳的。

en: Under the circumstances, we decided to stop the game early.
exzh: 在這種情況下，我們決定提早結束比賽。

en: Amy brought her own cup, and her classmates soon followed suit.
exzh: Amy 自備杯子，同學們很快也跟著這麼做。

en: Aside from math, Kevin likes all his school subjects.
exzh: 除了數學之外，Kevin 喜歡所有的學科。

en: The trip was fun, and best of all, it was free.
exzh: 這趟旅行很好玩，最棒的是還免費。

en: Staying up late often leads to poor grades.
exzh: 熬夜常會導致成績不好。

en: The cake was cheap. What's more, it tasted great.
exzh: 這蛋糕很便宜，而且味道還很棒。

en: The test was hard, and worse still, I forgot my pen.
exzh: 考試很難，更糟的是我還忘了帶筆。

en: Lisa learned how to deal with stress before big exams.
exzh: Lisa 學會了如何在大考前應付壓力。

en: Ben takes pleasure in helping younger students with homework.
exzh: Ben 樂於指導學弟妹寫功課。

en: I don't know how to go about writing a science report.
exzh: 我不知道該怎麼著手寫自然科報告。

en: The class set out to clean the park near our school.
exzh: 全班動身去打掃學校附近的公園。

en: Many students came to the station to send Amy off.
exzh: 許多同學到車站為 Amy 送行。

en: Mom is cooking dinner. In the meantime, I will set the table.
exzh: 媽媽在煮晚餐，這段時間我來擺碗筷。

en: The night market sells all manner of snacks.
exzh: 夜市賣各式各樣的小吃。

en: Our basketball club is looking to find a new coach.
exzh: 我們的籃球社想找一位新教練。

phrase: cost an arm and a leg
say: cost an arm and a leg
en: The new phone cost an arm and a leg, so Kevin kept his old one.
exzh: 那支新手機貴得嚇人，所以 Kevin 繼續用舊的。
targets: cost an arm and a leg

en: Can you give me a hand with these heavy books?
exzh: 你可以幫我搬這些很重的書嗎？

en: In science class, we build on what we learned last week.
exzh: 在自然課上，我們以上週學到的內容為基礎繼續往下學。

en: Lisa and her friends mapped out their trip to Tainan.
exzh: Lisa 和朋友們規劃了去台南的旅行。

en: I looked everywhere, but my umbrella was nowhere to be found.
exzh: 我到處找，卻怎麼也找不到我的雨傘。

en: Ben left his lunch box behind at home this morning.
exzh: Ben 今天早上把便當盒忘在家裡了。

en: Her good grades result from hard work every day.
exzh: 她的好成績來自每天的努力。

en: Kevin finished all his math homework in no time after dinner.
exzh: Kevin 吃完晚餐後，很快就把數學作業寫完了。

en: On top of homework, Amy has a part-time job on weekends.
exzh: 除了功課之外，Amy 週末還有一份兼職工作。

en: Learning a little English every day will help you in the long run.
exzh: 每天學一點英文，長遠來看會對你有幫助。

en: After class, Lisa made her way to the school gym.
exzh: 下課後，Lisa 前往學校的體育館。

phrase: at the drop of a hat
say: at the drop of a hat
en: Kevin will help his friends at the drop of a hat.
exzh: Kevin 會毫不猶豫地幫助朋友。
targets: at the drop of a hat

en: This old festival has its roots in farming life.
exzh: 這個古老的節慶起源於農家生活。

en: We left early so as to catch the first train.
exzh: 我們提早出發，以便趕上第一班火車。

en: The ball went back and forth across the net many times.
exzh: 球在網子兩邊來回飛了很多次。

en: As the afternoon wore on, the students grew sleepy.
exzh: 隨著下午時間慢慢過去，學生們愈來愈想睡。

en: The convenience store near my school is open around the clock.
exzh: 我學校附近的便利商店全天營業。

en: The medal is the fruit of Amy's long hours of practice.
exzh: 這面獎牌是 Amy 長時間練習的成果。

en: Learning English is by no means easy, but it is fun.
exzh: 學英文絕對不輕鬆，但很有趣。

en: It never crossed Amy's mind that the test would be moved to Friday.
exzh: Amy 從沒想過考試會改到星期五。

en: Mr. Chen made clear that phones are not allowed during the quiz.
exzh: 陳老師講明了小考期間不可以使用手機。

en: The bus is small, so only five students can get on at a time.
exzh: 這輛公車很小，所以一次只能上五位學生。

en: Kevin based his science report on the results of our own experiment.
exzh: Kevin 的自然科報告是根據我們自己的實驗結果寫的。

en: Players who skip warm-up exercises are at risk of hurting their legs.
exzh: 不做暖身運動的球員有傷到腿的風險。

en: Lisa tried to rise above the rude comments and keep smiling.
exzh: Lisa 努力不被那些無禮的評論影響，繼續保持微笑。

en: It is hard to strike a balance between homework and club activities.
exzh: 要在功課和社團活動之間取得平衡很不容易。

en: We argued for an hour, but in the end we chose the blue poster.
exzh: 我們爭論了一個小時，但最後選了藍色的海報。

en: Our badminton club is in need of new rackets this semester.
exzh: 我們羽球社這學期需要新的球拍。

en: As a whole, the class did well in the English speech contest.
exzh: 整體而言，全班在英語演講比賽中表現得很好。

en: All in all, the school trip to Tainan was a great experience.
exzh: 總的來說，這趟台南校外教學是很棒的經驗。

en: Ben checks his study plan every week to stay on track for the exam.
exzh: Ben 每週檢查讀書計畫，確保考試準備都照進度進行。

en: Dad asked us to clear out the old boxes from the storage room.
exzh: 爸爸要我們把儲藏室裡的舊箱子清出來。

en: Please make way for the students carrying the big science models.
exzh: 請讓路給搬著大型自然科模型的同學。

en: Whether we have the picnic depends on the weather tomorrow.
exzh: 我們能不能去野餐要看明天的天氣。

en: The senior player took Kevin under his wing and taught him new skills.
exzh: 那位學長把 Kevin 帶在身邊照顧，教他新的技巧。

en: This new phone comes with a free case and a charger.
exzh: 這支新手機附贈保護殼和充電器。

en: Let's work hard now so we can enjoy good results in the years to come.
exzh: 我們現在努力，就能在未來幾年享受好成果。

zh: 格格不入的人；人生地不熟
en: On his first day at the new school, Ben felt like a fish out of water.
exzh: 在新學校的第一天，Ben 覺得自己格格不入。

en: We all failed the quiz, so we are in the same boat.
exzh: 我們小考都沒過，所以大家處境一樣。

en: Our class cleaned the classroom from top to bottom before the visit.
exzh: 參訪之前，我們班把教室從上到下徹底打掃了一遍。

en: Lisa breathed a sigh of relief when she saw her name on the list.
exzh: Lisa 看到名單上有自己的名字時鬆了一口氣。

en: The loud music from the next room drowned out the teacher's voice.
exzh: 隔壁房間的大聲音樂蓋過了老師的聲音。

en: Pause for a moment and take in the beautiful view from the mountain top.
exzh: 停下來一會兒，好好欣賞山頂的美景。

en: Amy keeps a record of everything she spends in a small notebook.
exzh: Amy 用一本小筆記本記錄她所有的花費。

en: Mom still keeps my first drawing to this day.
exzh: 媽媽至今仍保存著我的第一張畫。

en: Our team's success was in large part due to good teamwork.
exzh: 我們隊的成功在很大程度上要歸功於良好的團隊合作。

en: This old song brings back happy memories of my elementary school days.
exzh: 這首老歌讓我想起小學時快樂的回憶。

en: Kevin ran to the station to arrive on time for the train.
exzh: Kevin 跑到車站，好準時趕上火車。

en: Without a doubt, Lisa is the best singer in our class.
exzh: 毫無疑問，Lisa 是我們班最會唱歌的人。

en: Mom took a day off to go to my school sports day.
exzh: 媽媽請了一天假來參加我們學校的運動會。

en: Ben looks after his little sister every afternoon after school.
exzh: Ben 每天下午放學後都要照顧他的妹妹。

en: Thousands of fans took to the streets to celebrate the team's win.
exzh: 成千上萬的球迷走上街頭慶祝球隊獲勝。

en: Traffic came to a standstill because of the heavy rain.
exzh: 因為大雨，交通完全停了下來。

en: The school took steps to keep the playground safe for everyone.
exzh: 學校採取了措施，讓每個人都能安全使用遊樂場。

en: Lisa is weak in math, and her tutor can help her in this regard.
exzh: Lisa 的數學不好，她的家教老師能在這方面幫她。

en: The student in question forgot to hand in his homework.
exzh: 我們說的那位學生忘了交作業。

en: Kevin was tired to such an extent that he fell asleep on the bus.
exzh: Kevin 累到在公車上睡著了。

en: Amy is fed up with waiting for the slow school bus every morning.
exzh: Amy 受夠了每天早上等那班很慢的校車。

en: Ben felt sick on the bumpy bus and almost threw up.
exzh: Ben 在顛簸的公車上覺得不舒服，差點吐出來。

en: Please take down the homework from the board before you leave.
exzh: 離開前請把黑板上的作業抄下來。

en: Lisa always stands up for her friends when someone treats them unfairly.
exzh: 有人對朋友不公平時，Lisa 總是挺身而出幫他們。

en: Even after losing the game, Kevin held his head up high.
exzh: 即使輸了比賽，Kevin 仍然昂首挺胸。

en: Can you come over to my house to study for the test?
exzh: 你可以來我家一起準備考試嗎？

en: The loud noise scared the birds off the school roof.
exzh: 巨大的聲響把鳥從學校屋頂上嚇跑了。

en: Our coach has high hopes for the basketball team this year.
exzh: 教練對今年的籃球隊期望很高。

en: I have more or less finished my science report.
exzh: 我的自然科報告差不多完成了。

en: When I hear the word "summer," the beach comes to mind.
exzh: 我一聽到「夏天」這個詞，腦中就浮現海灘。

en: New bubble tea shops spring up near our school every year.
exzh: 我們學校附近每年都冒出新的手搖飲料店。

en: Amy met her old teacher by chance at the night market.
exzh: Amy 在夜市碰巧遇到她以前的老師。

en: Our town is blessed with beautiful mountains and clean rivers.
exzh: 我們的小鎮得天獨厚，擁有美麗的山和乾淨的河。

en: Watch out! The floor in the science lab is wet.
exzh: 小心！自然科實驗室的地板是濕的。

en: On vacation, Ben played baseball to his heart's content.
exzh: 放假時，Ben 盡情地打棒球。

en: Don't leave your student card on the bus, or it may fall into the wrong hands.
exzh: 別把學生證留在公車上，不然可能會落到壞人手裡。

en: You need a password to log in to the school website.
exzh: 你需要密碼才能登入學校網站。

en: Visitors must sign in at the front desk before entering the school.
exzh: 訪客進入學校前必須先在櫃台簽到。

en: Lisa went the extra mile and practiced the speech ten more times.
exzh: Lisa 格外努力，又多練習了十次演講。

en: Please heat up the soup in the microwave for two minutes.
exzh: 請把湯放進微波爐加熱兩分鐘。

en: Kevin runs every morning to keep in shape for the basketball season.
exzh: Kevin 每天早上跑步，為籃球季保持良好體態。

en: The long hike pushed Amy to the limit, but she finished it.
exzh: 這趟長途健行把 Amy 逼到了極限，但她還是走完了。

en: Ben got cold feet just before he went on stage.
exzh: Ben 在上台前突然緊張退縮。

en: Many students sign up for the school choir at the start of the year.
exzh: 許多學生在學年初報名參加學校合唱團。

en: Mr. Lin started as a part-time worker and worked his way up to manager.
exzh: 林先生從工讀生做起，一步步升到經理。

en: Don't worry; before long, you will get used to the new school.
exzh: 別擔心，不久你就會習慣新學校的。

en: People from every walk of life came to the charity fair at our school.
exzh: 各行各業的人都來參加我們學校的義賣會。

en: Lisa laid out all her notes on the desk before studying.
exzh: 讀書之前，Lisa 把所有筆記攤在桌上。

en: Many traffic accidents in our city stem from careless driving.
exzh: 我們城市的許多交通事故都是由粗心駕駛造成的。

en: I can't get at the book on the top shelf without a ladder.
exzh: 沒有梯子我搆不到最上層架子上的書。

en: The singer's story struck a chord with many students in our school.
exzh: 那位歌手的故事引起了我們學校許多學生的共鳴。

en: Please turn off your phones prior to the start of the exam.
exzh: 請在考試開始之前把手機關機。

en: Mom stocked up on rice and water before the typhoon came.
exzh: 颱風來之前，媽媽囤了很多米和水。

en: I almost mistook the new teacher for a student.
exzh: 我差點把新來的老師誤認成學生。

en: Last but not least, I want to thank my parents for their support.
exzh: 最後但同樣重要的是，我要謝謝爸媽的支持。

en: Don't fall for online ads that promise easy money.
exzh: 別被承諾輕鬆賺錢的網路廣告騙了。

en: Let's take a look at the results of our experiment.
exzh: 我們來看看實驗的結果吧。

en: Ben and his brother are worlds apart in their tastes in music.
exzh: Ben 和他哥哥在音樂品味上天差地遠。

en: Summer in Taipei is hot and wet; by contrast, winter is cool.
exzh: 台北的夏天又熱又濕，相較之下，冬天就涼爽多了。

en: Girls make up about half of the members in our robot club.
exzh: 女生約占我們機器人社成員的一半。

zh: 從四面八方；從遠近各地
en: Visitors came from far and wide to see the lantern festival.
exzh: 遊客從四面八方來看燈會。

en: Fresh fruit and milk make for a healthy breakfast.
exzh: 新鮮水果配牛奶，就是一頓健康的早餐。

zh: 把⋯⋯放在心上；真心為⋯⋯著想
en: Our teacher always has our best interests at heart.
exzh: 我們的老師總是真心為我們著想。

en: Rest assured, we will finish the poster before the deadline.
exzh: 請放心，我們會在截止日前完成海報。

en: Walk to school, or better still, ride a bike.
exzh: 走路去學校，或者騎腳踏車更好。

zh: 造成損害；帶來沉重代價
en: Staying up late every night took a heavy toll on Kevin's health.
exzh: 每天熬夜對 Kevin 的健康造成了嚴重的損害。

en: In theory, the plan is simple, but it is hard to do in practice.
exzh: 理論上這個計畫很簡單，但實際做起來很難。

en: Amy won the contest, but at a price: she had to give up all her free weekends.
exzh: Amy 贏得了比賽，但也付出了代價：她不得不放棄所有空閒的週末。

en: Don't jump to conclusions before you hear the whole story.
exzh: 在聽完整個故事之前，不要妄下結論。

en: Please keep an eye on my bag while I buy a drink.
exzh: 我去買飲料時，請幫我看一下包包。

en: Kevin's speed sets him apart from the other runners.
exzh: Kevin 的速度讓他與其他跑者不同。

en: Ben missed the bus; in consequence, he was late for school.
exzh: Ben 錯過了公車，因此上學遲到了。

en: Farmers often have to contend with strong typhoons.
exzh: 農夫常常得應付強烈的颱風。

en: Too little sleep can result in poor grades.
exzh: 睡眠太少可能導致成績不好。

en: As a matter of fact, I have never been to Kaohsiung.
exzh: 事實上，我從來沒去過高雄。

en: The game was moved indoors owing to the heavy rain.
exzh: 由於大雨，比賽改到室內舉行。

en: The test was far from easy; most of us missed several questions.
exzh: 這次考試一點也不簡單，我們大多數人都錯了好幾題。

en: Our school's first science fair will go down in history.
exzh: 我們學校的第一場科學展覽會將會載入校史。

en: You can borrow my notes as long as you return them tomorrow.
exzh: 只要你明天還我，就可以借我的筆記。

en: The air was heavy with the smell of rain after the hot day.
exzh: 炎熱的一天過後，空氣中瀰漫著雨的氣味。

en: Amy hopes to live out her dream of becoming a science teacher.
exzh: Amy 希望實現她成為自然科老師的夢想。

en: I have yet to finish my homework for tomorrow's math class.
exzh: 我還沒寫完明天數學課的作業。
